name: model-routing
description: Cost-tiered subagents for Claude Code. Ships six agents — grunt, scout, chore, dev, sage, oracle — each pinning its own model and reasoning effort in frontmatter (haiku 4.5 for lookups, opus for code, fable 5.1 for thinking), which overrides the session's global effortLevel. A session-start hook injects the dispatch policy so work routes to the cheapest tier that can do it, and escalates only on observed failure.
